stemMd: A device converts input x into f(x)=4x−9. Which input gives output 19?
explanationMd: Solve 4x−9=19, so 4x=28 and x=7. Substituting 7 gives 28−9=19, which checks the result.

distractorRationale.c: The required inverse calculation is (19 + 9)/4 = 7; an input of 10 instead gives output 31.
distractorRationale.e: This applies the function to 19 rather than inverting it.
distractorRationale.a: This subtracts 9 from 19 instead of adding it.
